intro: Beef-A-Roo is the Midwest fast-food chain, born in Rockford, Illinois, best known for its roast beef sandwiches and its famous cheddar fries. Around them sits a full menu of burgers, crispy chicken, loaded potatoes, big salads and hand-dipped shakes. It is a regional favorite with a loyal following. Below is the full Beef-A-Roo menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Beef-A-Roo, a Roast Beef sandwich is about $6.70, a cheeseburger is $7.06, and a double cheeseburger is $10.11. Crispy chicken sandwiches are about $6.94, loaded potatoes run $5.36 to $6.33, and a medium shake is $5.60. The roast beef and the cheddar fries are the icons. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a roast beef at Beef-A-Roo?
faqs.a: A classic Roast Beef sandwich is about $6.70, the Jr Beef is $3.65, and the extra-large Big Beef is $8.77. Loaded versions like the Wild West Beef ($7.80) and Mushroom Swiss Beef ($8.04) cost a little more. Prices vary by location.

Cheddar fries are Beef-A-Roo's cult-favorite side: crispy fries topped with warm cheddar cheese sauce. They are one of the most ordered items at the chain and the thing most regulars add to any meal. A Jr Cheddar Fry is about $4.26.

Beef-A-Roo is a Midwest fast-food chain that started in Rockford, Illinois, with locations across Illinois and expansion into other states including Texas. It is a regional favorite rather than a coast-to-coast national chain.

Yes. Beef-A-Roo serves hand-dipped shakes in small, medium and large (about $3.77 to $7.92), a popular pairing with the roast beef and cheddar fries. Reviewers often single out the shakes as a highlight.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Beef-A-Roo?
faqs.a: The best known are the roast beef sandwich, the famous cheddar fries, the cheeseburger, the Wild West Beef, and the hand-dipped shakes.
